text:
Samir (CEO): Quick weekly note — thanks for the push this week. Two cross-org items I want everyone to be aware of:

1) EU Private launch: we cut GA for Private in eu-west-1 today (soft launch). Big thanks to Eng + Product + Ops. Primary asks: please monitor latency & billing dashboards closely for the next 72h, and flag any client regressions. Link: https://console.redwood/launchsheets/eu-private (internal). :tada:

2) Data retention policy update: Legal + Security and I agreed on a 90-day default retention for request logs and metrics for hosted plans, with an opt-out for enterprise contracts. This is to reduce scope for compliance reviews and lower storage costs. @Marta please post the formal policy doc and the FAQ tomorrow. :memo:

Priya (VP Product): Notes on EU Private rollout — feature matrix for GA is limited to v1 (no on-prem connectors yet). We kept parity on routing, caching, and canary policies. Next sprint focus: add KMS rotation UI and expand region choices. Please do not onboard new production customers to the GA cluster without a Solutions sync.

Jordan (VP Eng): Ops checklist in the deployment channel. We've enabled extra tracing for tokenization latency and bumped autoscaler thresholds by 10% for the new pool. If you see anomalous 'queue_depth' > 80%, ping eng-oncall and tag me. Rolling metrics ingest is scheduled for 00:00 UTC nightly.

Anya (Head of Ops): Incident summary from last night's brief outage — root cause was an autoscaler race when a cooldown trickle coincided with a heavy reroute from eu-west-2 -> eu-west-1. Mitigation deployed: increased stabilization window + added a fallback to a warm standby pool. Postmortem ongoing; ETA for publish EOD Friday. Action item owners: Jordan (autoscale fix), Priya (routing policy), Ops (playbook update).

Marta (Legal): Short heads-up on retention change: commercial teams — update any active SOWs that reference custom retention. For enterprises that require <90d retention we will need explicit waiver language + security review. I'll post the template waiver and a PR checklist tomorrow.

release-bot: deploy succeeded: service/eu-private:v1.2.0 @ 1988881200 — changelog: reduced cold-start latency, fixed token-kv leak. Logs: /var/log/releases/eu-private/1988881200.log

Samir (CEO): Thanks everyone. Two asks from me: 1) org leads, DM me any customer names you plan to migrate this week (we'll gate manual migrations), and 2) product & legal, confirm the public-facing wording for retention so marketing can update docs by Monday. Low priority: remember cost target for Q2 — try to preserve current batching defaults unless we see a spike in latency. :pray:

Priya (VP Product): Acknowledged. I'll coordinate the doc language with Marta and loop marketing.

Jordan (VP Eng): Acknowledged. Will post autoscale PR & before/after graphs in eng-ops channel when merged.

Anya (Head of Ops): Will publish incident draft by EOD today.

Marta (Legal): Will share waiver template and the policy page copy by tomorrow morning.

Samir (CEO): Appreciate it — short sync Monday 09:30 PT for cross-org checkpoint. If anything urgent, use #release-war-room. :white_check_mark:
